GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Current Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Motion 3.5 Electromagnetic Spectrum Page 12 of  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Projectile Motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic Spectrum Page 12 of 55 1 STRAND 1.0 LIFE SCIENCE Strand Sub Stra and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic Spectrum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
